display.purpose: Brand and page titles; Chakra Petch bold.

body.purpose: Default UI copy and button labels at 15px.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Single go-action per view — Join, Ready, Continue.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--on-primary); background: var(--primary); border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-md); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--border-strong); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text); background: var(--bg-raised); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-overlay); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--border-strong); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; color: var(--text); background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-md); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--bg-overlay); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--border-strong); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Money Amount
components.description: Wallet balance and prize pool figures.
components.css: .ds-money { color: var(--money); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Tier Badge
components.description: Average tier on lobby rows; bar color follows band.
components.css: .ds-tier-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-tier-bar { width: 3px; height: 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); } .ds-tier-pro { background: var(--tier-pro); } .ds-tier-mid { background: var(--tier-mid); } .ds-tier-low { background: var(--tier-low); } .ds-tier-label { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--text); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Seat Meter
components.css: .ds-seat-meter { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; } .ds-seat { width: 6px; height: 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); } .ds-seat.ready { background: var(--primary); } .ds-seat.joined { background: var(--text-muted); } .ds-seat.open { background: var(--bg-overlay); }

components.name: Play Header Strip
components.html: BulaaPlay₮ 500,000
components.css: .ds-play-header { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg-void); } .ds-play-header-inner { max-width: 64rem; margin: 0 auto; height: 3.5rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 1rem; gap: 1rem; } .ds-brand { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-brand:hover { color: var(--primary); } .ds-play-label { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted); }

narrative.overview: Bulaa looks like a night-shift ops desk for paid CS2 lobbies: void-black canvas, flat raised panels, and a single lime channel for actions that move money or match state forward. The UI is competitive and impatient—short labels, mono for counts and IDs, gold tabular figures for MNT—not a casino floor with neon stacks or jackpot theatrics.
keyCharacteristics: Flat depth via background steps, not drop shadows
Lime primary for one CTA per view; blue accent for links
Money gold reserved for MNT with tabular numerals
Sharp 4–6px radii; tier badges use left accent bar
MN + EN; Chakra Petch + IBM Plex

rules.name: The One Primary Rule
rules.body: At most one lime primary CTA per view.

rules.name: The Money Lane Rule
rules.body: Wallet and prize pool amounts use money with tabular nums. Never lime text on yellow/gold chips.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: No card chrome in heroes. No glow stacks on CTAs. Shadows are not part of the core vocabulary.

rules.name: The Cyrillic Rule
rules.body: MN strings must render cleanly; do not substitute Inter, Roboto, or Arial as primary UI fonts.

dos: Do import @bulaa/design/tokens.css once at app root.
Do use tabular-money for all MNT displays.
Do keep copy short and imperative.
Do use success / danger for win/loss.
Do say players joined or are in the lobby.
donts: Don't ship a light theme or purple brand accents.
Don't use casino language or visuals.
Don't use Find Match or draft as primary product verbs.
Don't invent new brand hex colors.
Don't stack multiple lime primary buttons on one screen.
